name: open
description: Open a single-web window: one tab showing `url`, a read-only address, back / forward / reload and the OS caption buttons. The window is pinned to the kSingleWeb UI mode, is never restored by session restore, and belongs to the connection that opened it: its events (onNavigated, onTitleChanged, onClosed) go to that connection only, and it is closed when that connection goes away. Only http, https and file URLs are accepted. With `captureRedirect` (a loopback http URL with an explicit port: localhost, 127.0.0.1 or [::1], no credentials; invalid_args otherwise) a main-frame navigation in the window that starts at, or is redirected to, that URL (scheme, host, port and path equal; query and fragment ignored) is cancelled before any request reaches the port, onRedirectCaptured { windowId, url } (the full URL, query included) goes to the owning connection, and the window is then closed (onClosed reason 'api'). At most one capture per window; `url` itself may not match captureRedirect. Manifest primitive webWindow.captureRedirect. With `title` (1–120 characters after whitespace runs collapse; invalid_args otherwise) the window's title row and its OS window title show that text for the window's whole life, whatever the page sets as document.title; onTitleChanged and list still report the page's own title. Manifest primitive webWindow.title. With `awaitSignInResult` (requires `captureRedirect`; invalid_args otherwise) the window stays open after onRedirectCaptured and shows the host's 'Finishing sign-in' page until showSignInResult reports the outcome. Manifest primitive webWindow.signInResult. With `isolatedSession` the window runs in a session made for it alone, a storage partition of the profile kept in memory: no cookie or site data of the profile is in it, it is shared with no other window, and what it stored is cleared when the window is gone. Manifest primitive webWindow.isolatedSession. With `storagePartition` (8 to 32 lower-case letters; invalid_args otherwise, and with isolatedSession) the window runs in the kept session of that name, a storage partition of the profile on disk: no cookie or site data of the profile is in it, and the same name opens the same session again, in a later run too, until deleteStoragePartition. Either way the profile's saved passwords, autofill and extensions still apply. Manifest primitive webWindow.storagePartition. Returns { windowId }.

inputs.name: url
inputs.description: The page to show: an http, https or file URL.

inputs.name: left
inputs.description: Screen x of the window's top-left corner, in DIPs.

inputs.name: top
inputs.description: Screen y of the window's top-left corner, in DIPs.

inputs.name: width
inputs.description: Window width in DIPs, at least 200.

inputs.name: height
inputs.description: Window height in DIPs, at least 150.

inputs.name: focus
inputs.description: Activate the window once shown. Absent: true.

inputs.name: captureRedirect
inputs.description: A loopback http URL (localhost, 127.0.0.1 or [::1], explicit port, no credentials) whose navigation is captured and reported as onRedirectCaptured instead of sent.

inputs.name: title
inputs.description: A fixed window title, shown in the title row and as the OS window title instead of the page's title; the page cannot change it.

inputs.name: awaitSignInResult
inputs.description: With captureRedirect: keep the window open after the capture, showing a 'Finishing sign-in' page, until showSignInResult. Absent: false (the window closes on capture).

inputs.name: isolatedSession
inputs.description: Open the window in a session of its own, shared with nothing and cleared when the window is gone. Absent: false (the profile's session).

inputs.name: storagePartition
inputs.description: Open the window in the kept session of this name (8 to 32 lower-case letters). Absent: the profile's session.
